environment_note: Thresholds are deliberately conservative for shared GitHub runners (which are slower and noisier than development machines). Baseline values are ~10-20x lower than dev-machine measurements. The goal is to catch CATASTROPHIC regressions (O(n²) replacing O(n), broken cache, etc.), not micro-optimizations. Update baseline_value when intentional changes alter performance characteristics.

benchmarks.name: GovernanceCacheHit
benchmarks.notes: In-process map lookup. Dev machine: ~4M RPS. Baseline ~500k for CI. Fail at 80% drop (100k RPS) signals broken cache or major lock contention.

benchmarks.name: GovernanceEvaluate
benchmarks.notes: Service.Evaluate() with cached policy. Dev machine: ~3.6M RPS. Conservative CI baseline.

benchmarks.name: ChainHMACVerify
benchmarks.notes: HMAC-SHA256 per-row computation. Dev machine: ~143k RPS. Stable pure-CPU benchmark. Regression signals algorithm change or crypto library issue.

benchmarks.name: ChainAnchorSign
benchmarks.notes: Ed25519 anchor signing. Dev machine: ~17k RPS. Pure crypto; stable across environments.

benchmarks.name: ChainAnchorVerify
benchmarks.notes: Ed25519 anchor verification. Dev machine: ~7.9k RPS.

benchmarks.name: StreamingDecodeEmit
benchmarks.notes: Full SSE decode+emit round-trip (5 events). Dev machine: ~1500 RPS. Large tolerance due to CI scheduler jitter and I/O variance.

benchmarks.name: StreamingDecodeOnly
benchmarks.notes: Decoder only, no emit. Dev machine: ~1580 RPS.

benchmarks.name: StreamingEmitSanitized
benchmarks.notes: EmitSanitized JSON re-encoding path (F7.5). Dev machine: ~29k RPS. Fail at 80% drop signals broken JSON marshal path.

benchmarks.name: SIEMEnqueueNormal
benchmarks.notes: Non-blocking async queue enqueue. Dev machine: ~2.6M events/s. Very conservative baseline; 90% drop (5k/s) signals blocking or lock regression.
